context.transcript:
Will you be attending the mandatory training session today or tomorrow?
A. He tends to agree with me.
B. I'm spending today with a client.
C. Copies of the proposed agenda.
context.transcript_translation:
你今天还是明天会参加强制性培训课程？
A. 他倾向于同意我。
B. 我今天和一位客户在一起。
C. 拟议议程的副本。

items.question: Will you be attending the mandatory training session today or tomorrow?
choices: He tends to agree with me.
I'm spending today with a client.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：选择问今天还是明天参加培训，答句说今天要陪客户。 选择理由：B排除了 today，间接表明会选 tomorrow；A和C没有回应日期选择。正确答案：B（I'm spending today with a client.）。
items.evidence: 参考原文第 1 段第 1 句：Will you be attending the mandatory training session today or tomorrow?
choice_translations: B：我今天和一位客户在一起。
